site.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/158.0.8127.18 Safari/537.36
site.domainNote: Drawphone (telephone-pictionary party game) — archive of past game results saved on device

view.name: Previous results list
view.description: List of past game results saved on the device, grouped by date, each entry summarizing chains.

regions.label: Centered heading 'Your Previous Results' with subtitle and rule
Date-grouped list-group of clickable result buttons, each a time + word-chain summary
Exit Archive button, rule, credit and GitHub link

evidence.quote: 08:16 PM: minion to hot dog, slither to noodle, etc.
evidence.note: Each row is a button summarizing a game; clicking replaces the view with 'Results #1' showing full drawing/guess chain (verified live, URL unchanged)
Reverse-chronological record of the person's own past games grouped by day; reads more as a saved-items archive than an event log

patterns.rationale: It's a time-ordered history of past games, but it's a collection of saved artifacts rather than a log of changes/actors; could be coded as just an overview list.

structure.layout: single narrow centered column (452px) on white: heading, date-grouped bordered list-groups, exit button, footer

aesthetics.typography: Pangolin (handwritten-style rounded sans) for everything: heading, date labels, list buttons, footer
aesthetics.typeScale: Low contrast: 32px h2 heading, 20px Exit button, 16px for subtitle, date labels and all rows; regular weight throughout

notes: Bootstrap list-group styling with the Pangolin handwriting font giving a playful character. Each date header is plain text above a bordered stack of full-width centered button rows ('HH:MM PM: firstword to lastguess, ..., etc.'). Very long page (5742px) with no pagination, search or filters. Clicking a row swaps the view to a results chain (word -> drawing -> guess). Footer credit link in blue #003fb2.
